title: We've launched our trailer for "Survive a Night with a Vampire"!🧛‍♀️
author: NoAutoPilotYT

comments.author: NoAutoPilotYT
comments.body:
So, we're closing in on a major milestone. The release of our storytelling game Survive a Night with a Vampire.

With this being the 11th version of the trailer we've made, we're excited to FINALLY share it with you.

Of course, the best way to support us is by joining the waitlist, which you can find here.

[https://inciteworlds.com](https://inciteworlds.com)  


Will you survive the night?

❤️Team Incite
